elements.title: Karl Malte von Heinz (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Karl Malte von Heinz designed the Vatican, Pakistani, Yugoslav and Thai diplomatic missions in India?

elements.title: Los Solidarios (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that the anarchist group Los Solidarios assassinated the leader of the Catalan pistoleros, the governor of Biscay, and the archbishop of Zaragoza?

elements.title: Peter Miller (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that photographer Peter Miller stated in 2014 that the "Vermont Way" of grumbling and every so often remembering that "we live in beauty" was "coming to an end"?

elements.title: their Yiddish encyclopedia (Wikipedia — did you know?)

elements.title: a crossover event (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that the unlicensed Willy's Chocolate Experience in Scotland led to a crossover event between the American television series Abbott Elementary and It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia?
